_comment: Simulated sign-in (no passwords). Personas and the permission matrix. V = view, A = act, - = hidden. The server enforces all of it. The process ends at the DRI's decision, so there is no Finance persona.

users.name: Maya Chen
users.title: CSR / Billing Operations
users.rights: Receives disputes and new cases; looks up an account to have the agents check it; confirms triage and ID matches (evidence only); sends back-scan findings into the workflow. No decision or approval rights.

users.name: Daniel Okoro
users.title: DRI – Billing Exceptions Lead
users.rights: The single and final decision point: approves the recommendation or another option, releases as-is, or cancels as a false positive. The decision closes and seals the case.
